title: Zesty Nutty Saudi Arabian Lamb Pilaf
description: A one-pot Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb, red chilli flakes, and nuts, cooked to a glassy jelly consistency in a stone bowl, suitable for diabetic diets. This recipe combines the flavors of the Middle East with a nutty twist.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large stone bowl over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the red chilli flakes, salt, and chopped almonds, stirring to combine.
Add the basmati rice and stir to combine with the lamb and spice mixture.
Add 2 cups of water to the bowl and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the bowl, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is cooked.
Remove the bowl from the heat and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
